name: VENDIX AI
display_name: VENDIX AI - Autonomous Vendor Risk & Compliance Governance Agent
description: Enterprise-grade autonomous agent that evaluates vendor risk across 12 compliance policies (SOC2, ISO27001, Data Residency, Payment Terms, Security Posture) and enforces human-in-the-loop approval with SHA256 tamper-proof audit trail. Built for procurement & compliance teams.
author: Raveena Sharma
qualified_run_definition: A Qualified App Run is counted when a signed-in user submits a vendor payload and receives a complete risk_assessment with score, level, flags, and audit_hash_sha256
